remaining.answerFragment: Subsection 125(9) allows listed section 53 powers and functions, powers respecting particular uses, a Minister letter for one section 53 requirement, possible regional service commission powers, Consolidated Fund treatment and possible return of a fee, deemed vesting of certain proposed-use and variance powers, and Minister orders or agreements for rezoning applications with section 59 applying with necessary modifications.

remaining.message: Objective euba491-2 may change legal modality for question "What must have happened before a non-party regulator may assist the Board under subsection 49.1(2)?".
remaining.answerFragment: The Board must apply following the commencement of a proceeding resulting from the application of financial and consumer services legislation, and the regulator must not already be a party to the proceedings.
remaining.sourceFragment:
49.1(1)For the purposes of this section, “regulator” means a regulator as defined in the Financial and Consumer Services Commission Act.
